en.headline: Police upgrade Anita Mui ashes case to New Territories South regional unit
en.dek: The investigation into the missing urn of the late Cantopop singer, reported three months ago at Po Lin Monastery, has been transferred from the Lantau district squad.
body: Hong Kong police have transferred the investigation into the missing ashes of late Cantopop singer Anita Mui to the New Territories South regional crime unit, a spokesman said on Tuesday.

The case was originally classified as a request for police assistance and handled by the Lantau district crime squad after a report on 18 July that an item was missing from Po Lin Monastery on Lantau Island. No one has been arrested.

Mui’s family had said over the weekend that the urn was discovered missing three months ago, causing distress, and that earlier inquiries had made no progress. The transfer commits additional resources to the case.

zh.headline: 警方將梅艷芳骨灰失蹤案升級由新界南總區重案組跟進
zh.dek: 已故歌手骨灰於7月在大嶼山寶蓮禪寺失蹤的個案，原由離島區重案組處理，現轉交更高層級單位，暫未有人被捕。
body: 警方發言人周二表示，已故歌手梅艷芳的骨灰失蹤調查已轉交新界南總區重案組跟進。
個案原列作尋求警方協助，由離島區重案組處理。警方於7月18日接獲報案，指大嶼山寶蓮禪寺有物品失蹤。至今未有人被捕。
梅艷芳家人周末表示，骨灰約三個月前被發現失蹤，令家人十分困擾，早期調查未有進展。是次轉交意味投入更多資源跟進。
